payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcome.target: A recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl, within the bowl opening rather than on the lid, tank, rim, or nearby floor.
outcome.reference: The toilet bowl in the input image.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly within the toilet bowl opening, inside the rim; it is not merely on the lid, tank, rim, or nearby floor.
check.partial_when: A frog has been added to the toilet area but is only on the lid, tank, rim, or nearby floor, with no frog visibly inside the bowl.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to or placed at the toilet.
check.unknown_when: The toilet bowl or relevant area cannot be assessed, or the evidence is ambiguous.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows a recognizable green frog visibly inside the toilet bowl opening. Additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor, but the bowl frog fulfills the requested placement."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image shows a recognizable green frog visibly inside the toilet bowl opening. Additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor, but the bowl frog fulfills the requested placement.
